neighbours.label: the boundary after a general claim in technical exposition, where 'for example' or a '(see …)' reference follows
fire: A group homomorphism preserves the identity element; for example, the trivial map sends everything to zero.

Covalent bonds form when atoms share electron pairs; for instance, methane has four such bonds.

quiet: My sister moved to a small flat near the river last summer and loves it.

notes: Card peaks on '.', ';', ' for', ' In', ' See' just before 'For example', 'In turn', '(see n. 49)', in definitional math/physics/doc text. The pole fires on the punctuation BEFORE the cue, so it reads the claim, not the cue. Probe: 0.71 and 0.77 on such sentences, 0.03 on plain narrative. Near misses are plain everyday statements of similar length without an example or reference break.
